author: Marcus R. Brown
description:
- Introduce `wasm-benchmarks.ts` for comprehensive benchmarking of WASM module loading, instantiation, and memory management.
- Implement `benchmark.ts` for performance measurement utilities, including statistical analysis and memory tracking.
- Create `performance-optimizations.ts` for caching, memory pooling, lazy loading, and debouncing strategies to enhance application performance.
- Add optimized caching mechanisms and memory management techniques to reduce garbage collection pressure.
- Establish global optimization instances for shared use across the application.

Closes #946.
title: feat: add WASM performance benchmarking suite and utilities
